description: Add OpenRouter as a third AI provider alongside Anthropic and Gemini, supporting 100+ models through a single API key.
steps: Create server/lib/openrouterClient.js with OpenRouter API integration using built-in https module
Update README.md to document OpenRouter as a provider option
Add tests in server/tests/aiProvider.test.js for openrouter provider path
acceptance_criteria: openrouterClient.js uses the OpenRouter REST API at https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions
API key sent as Bearer token in Authorization header
Uses same system prompt logic from getSystemPrompt()
Uses Node.js built-in https module only
Error message lists all three providers
All existing tests pass plus new openrouter tests
findings: All 79 tests pass (3 new OpenRouter tests added). No external dependencies used. OpenRouter client follows the same pattern as geminiClient.js (imports shared utilities from claudeClient.js). The unsupported provider error message now lists all three options.
